cases.name: Profitable software company
cases.scenario: Recurring-revenue company with positive EBITDA and complete capital structure.
expected_behaviors: Preserve LTM reported periods and evidence.
Produce EV/Revenue and EV/EBITDA ranges.
Bridge enterprise value to equity and per-share value.

cases.name: High-growth company with negative EBITDA
cases.scenario: Revenue is positive while EBITDA and earnings are negative.
expected_behaviors: Retain revenue multiples.
Mark EV/EBITDA and P/E not meaningful.
Explain the exclusion without deleting raw values.

cases.name: Industrial company with debt
cases.scenario: Positive operating metrics with material debt and cash.
expected_behaviors: Add debt and subtract cash in EV.
Reverse the signs in the target equity bridge.
Keep bridge component IDs.

cases.name: Mixed reported and adjusted EBITDA
cases.scenario: Peer observations contain different EBITDA bases.
expected_behaviors: Never pool reported and adjusted denominators.
Return missing input for an unavailable requested basis.
Preserve the denominator basis.

cases.name: Stale or missing market data
cases.scenario: A peer has a stale price or an incomplete EV bridge.
expected_behaviors: Reject stale equity value inputs.
Return an unavailable numerator when debt is missing.
Propagate quality warnings.

cases.name: Incomplete target capital structure
cases.scenario: Target metric is usable but debt or cash is absent.
expected_behaviors: Preserve implied enterprise value.
Leave equity and per-share values unavailable.
Explain the missing bridge input.

cases.name: Forward estimates available
cases.scenario: Peers have FY2027E revenue, EBITDA, and EPS.
expected_behaviors: Calculate forward multiples separately from LTM.
Keep FY2027E labels.
Never fabricate a target forward range when target forecasts are absent.

cases.name: No meaningful P/E
cases.scenario: A peer has negative EPS and net income.
expected_behaviors: Mark P/E not meaningful.
Retain the negative EPS input.
Avoid false certainty in explanation.
